market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Active US-Iran negotiations with one-page 14-point MOU under review including possible sanctions relief. WaPo reported some Iranian oil sanctions easing in March 2026. Whether this resolves YES depends on exact criteria; given active negotiations that could close by May 31, estimate ~30-40%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Exact resolution criteria; whether ongoing negotiations conclude before May 31.
